class Box<T> { constructor(public value: T) {} }
class NumberBox extends Box<number> {}
new NumberBox("x");
class StringBox extends Box<string> {}
new StringBox(123);
class Pair<T, U = string> { constructor(public first: T, public second: U) {} }
class NumberPair extends Pair<number> {}
new NumberPair(1, 2);
class ListBox<U> extends Box<U[]> {}
new ListBox<number>(["a"]);
class SmallBox extends NumberBox {}
new SmallBox("x");
class WithList<T, U = T[]> { constructor(public first: T, public rest?: U) {} }
class NumberList extends WithList<number> {}
new NumberList(1, [2]);
new NumberList(1, ["x"]);
class Wrapper extends Box<number> { constructor() { super("a"); } }
class Inner extends NumberBox { constructor() { super("x"); } }
const Anonymous = class extends Box<string> {};
new Anonymous(1);
